main.description: Open access requests for a forum. With kind=board (the default): accessRequest records pointing at this forum's members-only boards, minus ones already denied, with requester profile and board name for display. With kind=forum: applications to join the forum itself, one per applicant, each carrying its current state (pending, waiting, or denied) from the newest decision.

requester.description: With kind=forum: only this account's application, for a point lookup.
